designStatus: accepted by coordinator for OBS-004 implementation

tables.materialization: session PK; session/scope composite FK; immutable source/configuration identities, approved input table and authoredInputsHash; frozen before admission
tables.preparations: immutable authenticated proof and full scoped identities; expiry; single-assignment admission with unique association
tables.pendingAllocations: session/binding PK and session/need uniqueness; immutable producer intent; cumulative prospective consumers
tables.producerEvidence: same-session allocation/admission FKs; one read per binding; immutable recipe/origin/coordinate; value-free availability bound to worker/fence/context
tables.consumerEdges: session/consumerAdmission/argumentSlot PK; same-session producer/action FKs; immutable coordinate/destination/policy

requirements: Reuse V30 session row serialization, command digest deduplication, immutable ledger and terminal protections. Preserve V30; add same-session action/admission uniqueness for composite FKs.

No ambient transaction at dispatch entry. Dedicated consume transaction must actually commit before returning ephemeral WonConsumption and making one transport send. Nested REQUIRED return is insufficient.
Never store/replay winning authority in generic command responses; same-key and new-key repeats return AlreadyConsumed. Stored proposal is executable source of truth.
Persist authenticated preparation after network response, then validate scope/fence/context in a short locked transaction. No network call under DB lock.
Admission atomically validates current source/account, proof, input hash, binding prerequisites and budgets; attaches proof and concrete consumer edges.
Read outcome atomically updates ledger, inserts separate producer receipt, increments revision and deduplicates; changed receipt conflicts even when ledger identical.
No values, value hashes, lengths or samples in producer evidence; captured values remain worker-local.
Use consistent authoritative source/configuration and session/bridge lock order. Current permissions checked before cached status. Historical status is never live authority.
Cancellation invalidates unused preparations/context with ledger transitions. Historic producer success never proves live value availability after teardown.
Use explicit NOT NULL/CHECK relational identity constraints. V30 ledger trigger prohibits receipt append; use separate table. Named INSERT columns required if changing actions columns.
OBS-004 owns necessary migration-test target/count updates and new actual concurrency tests.
tests: Same/different-key race: one committed winner/one send
Nested rollback/commit failure and cache replay: no additional send
Preparation reuse/digest/context and cross-session FK negatives
Atomic producer outcome rollback and conflicting duplicate receipt
Consumer admission race with producer completion
Actual source/configuration row mutation versus admission/consume locking
Fresh install and V30-to-V31 migration retain immutable/terminal protections
